scope: Manual RTL inspection tied to actual simulation failures; no candidate repair or rescoring.

failures.rtl_cause: psel_q is a one-hot mask (1/2/4), but pready[psel_q], pslverr[psel_q] and prdata[32*psel_q +: 32] use it as a binary index. Target0 selects lane1; target2 index4 is outside the vector.

failures.observed: BRESP mismatch before and after edits
failures.rtl_cause: tgt is a one-hot mask but still used as pready[tgt], pslverr[tgt], prdata[32*tgt +: 32]. Two verdict-only FAILs and two subsequent edits did not remove this error.

failures.observed: VCS ICPSD illegal combination of drivers on s_awready
failures.rtl_cause: s_awready is assigned both by continuous assign and always_comb. No functional simulation completed for this submission.

repair_example.observed: public FAIL -> edit -> public FAIL -> edit -> terminal and held-out PASS
repair_example.first_failure: APB VIP penable_after_psel: sel_q remains asserted in RESP while PENABLE drops; this creates an apparent new Setup with no following Access. The initial candidate also accepts any target PREADY rather than only the selected lane.
repair_example.second_failure: Unmapped response remains in IDLE instead of RESP, so VALID is not retired after handshake; checker reports response without completion credit on the next cycle.
repair_example.final_change: First edit clears sel_q on completion and selects only the active PREADY lane; final edit enters RESP for unmapped read/write so VALID retires normally.
repair_example.causal_limit: Temporal feedback/edit linkage is observed; model intent and causal policy advantage are not established.
